questions.question: What did Balaam continue to do in his oracles?
options: Bless Israel and prophesy their future
Demand more silver and gold for himself
Curse Israel before the king of Moab
Stand silent and refuse to speak
questions.answer: Bless Israel and prophesy their future

questions.question: What did Balaam foretell would come out of Jacob?
options: A famine lasting seven long years
A priest to bless all the nations
A star and a scepter (a ruler)
A flood covering the whole land
questions.answer: A star and a scepter (a ruler)

questions.question: Balak was angry that Balaam had blessed Israel three times.
Balaam prophesied, "A _____ will come out of Jacob," a scepter out of Israel.
Balak's anger burned, and he struck his _____ together against Balaam.
